courses.name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Introduces AI approaches, history, applications and ethical questions through applied projects.
courses.prerequisites: COGS 18 or CSE 11 or CSE 6R or CSE 8A or CSE 8B or DSC 20

courses.name: Foundations of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
courses.description: Builds mathematical and programming foundations for AI, including optimization and representation learning.
courses.prerequisites: CSE 12 and CSE 25 and CSE 15L or CSE 29 and MATH 18 or MATH 31AH and MATH 20C or MATH 31BH

courses.name: Advanced Data Structures
courses.description: Studies implementation and performance of advanced data structures.
courses.prerequisites: CSE 21 or MATH 154 or MATH 158 or MATH 184 or MATH 188 and CSE 12 and CSE 15L or CSE 29 or ECE 15

courses.name: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
courses.description: Analyzes algorithm design, complexity and computational difficulty.
courses.prerequisites: CSE 21 or MATH 154 or MATH 158 or MATH 184 or MATH 188 and CSE 12 or DSC 30

courses.name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence: Probabilistic Reasoning and Decision-Making
courses.description: Studies probabilistic inference, uncertainty and decision-making in intelligent systems.
courses.prerequisites: CSE 12 or DSC 40B and CSE 15L or CSE 29 or DSC 80 and COGS 118D or CSE 103 or ECE 109 or ECON 120A or MAE 108 or MATH 180A or MATH 180B or MATH 181A or MATH 183 or MATH 186 and MATH 20A and MATH 18 or MATH 31AH

courses.name: Machine Learning: Learning Algorithms
courses.description: Introduces supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms and their underlying principles.
courses.prerequisites: CSE 12 or DSC 40B and CSE 15L or CSE 29 or DSC 80 and COGS 118D or CSE 103 or ECE 109 or ECON 120A or MAE 108 or MATH 180A or MATH 180B or MATH 181A or MATH 183 or MATH 186 and MATH 18 or MATH 31AH and MATH 20C or MATH 31BH

requirements.title: AI major: 124 units excluding college general education
requirements.summary: AI major: 124 units excluding college general education

requirements.title: Lower-division computing elective
requirements.summary: At least four units from the named pool or an unused upper-division CSE course.

requirements.title: AI electives
requirements.summary: Twelve units from this pool, not used for other core or breadth requirements.

requirements.title: Systems breadth
requirements.summary: At least eight units carrying this approved tag. Full CSE tag mapping remains unreviewed.

requirements.title: Theory/Abstraction breadth
requirements.summary: At least eight units carrying this approved tag. Full CSE tag mapping remains unreviewed.

requirements.title: Applications of Computing breadth
requirements.summary: At least eight units carrying this approved tag. Full CSE tag mapping remains unreviewed.

requirements.title: Additional CSE or tagged electives
requirements.summary: Unused upper-division or graduate CSE courses, or non-CSE courses with an approved breadth tag.

requirements.title: Approved non-CSE elective pool
requirements.summary: Eligibility is subject to the tag and overlap rules in the cited catalog section; this row is an option pool.

requirements.title: CSE elective eligibility
requirements.summary: CSE 100–194 may count if unused elsewhere; CSE 180, 180R and 191 are excluded. Graduate coursework needs a petition.

requirements.title: Topics-course limit
requirements.summary: CSE 190 and graduate analogue CSE 291 share a maximum of twelve units / three distinct topics.

requirements.title: P/NP and special studies
requirements.summary: At most twelve P/NP units: up to eight in CSE 198/199/199H, four in CSE 197, and two in CSE 109. Exceeding the special-studies limit requires faculty-reviewed petition.

requirements.title: Global Ties limit
requirements.summary: Up to eight ENG 100D/L units within the special-studies maximum; ENG 100D may count only once.

requirements.title: Letter grades
requirements.summary: All courses require letter grades except courses offered only P/NP.

requirements.title: Graduate degree reuse
requirements.summary: Graduate coursework counted in the undergraduate degree cannot also count in a graduate degree.
